meta.narrative_direction: 부정형(중국) + 한국 측 일부 긍정형 = 혼합. 근거 — concept.md 감정 아크가 '어이없음 → 억울함 → 통쾌함 절정(일조 달러 벌고도 뱃머리를 돌렸다) → 자부심 착지(밤새 불 켜진 우리 도크)'다. 중국은 몰락이 아니라 '자충수·후퇴·허세 폭로'라 국기를 태우지 않고 온전하되 그을음·소금기로 탁하게 두어 '깃발은 거대한데 그 아래는 멈춰 있다'는 모순을 만든다. 한국 측은 파트 4(포항·여수)에서 부정형(억울함), 파트 8(도크·조선 우위)에서 긍정형(자부심)으로 갈라 배치했다. ⛔ 태극기는 어떤 장에서도 훼손하지 않는다.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render. Scene: camera at standing eye level on a stone breakwater, looking straight down a sea channel so the water and the flanking headlands converge to a vanishing point deep inside the frame. The entire sky above, edge to edge and taking the whole upper band of the left eight-tenths, is an enormous Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — rendered as real weighted cloth with deep rippling folds and visible weave, intact but grimy, sun-bleached and soot-stained, glowing dull red against black smoke. Under that sky the channel is completely dead: a single crude tanker is caught mid-turn with its wake bending into a long curved scar across the water, and beyond it, penned outside the channel mouth, a stalled crowd of tanker silhouettes sits motionless in orange haze; not one vessel is under way. Cracked-glass shards and torn scorched edges run across the horizon as a broadcast graphic treatment. Occupying the right two-tenths of the frame as a hard-edged cut-out portrait layer, chest up and about six-tenths of the image height, stands Xi Jinping (President of China): his gaze dropped completely to the lower left and away from the water, upper eyelids drooping, the inner ends of his eyebrows lifted, his mouth caught half open as if a sentence stopped, chin drawn back so the throat creases, no hands in frame, a low orange firelight keying the side of his face so it stays bright against the dark.
